Overview

A GNPS workflow for automatically selecting candidate reference MS/MS spectra from LC-MS data of known standards using supplied molecular structures and expected precursor masses.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Reference-spectrum selectionMS/MS processing

Common uses

  • Select MS/MS spectra corresponding to known standards from open-format data.
  • Prepare candidate reference spectra for validation and library contribution.

Scientific fit

Primary function

Spectral processing and comparison

Other functions

Metabolite annotation and identification

Analysis types

Targeted metabolomics, Metabolite profiling

MS level

MS/MS

Acquisition

Targeted MS/MS, Flow injection, Data-dependent acquisition (DDA)

Ion mobility

Ion mobility not required

Data compatibility

Inputs

Mass spectra, Molecular structures

Outputs

Mass spectra, Human-readable report

Input formats

mzML, mzXML, CSV or TSV, SMILES or InChI

Output formats

CSV or TSV

Scope and considerations

Designed for

  • Extracting candidate reference MS/MS scans when structures or formulas of standards are known.

Important requirements

  • Open-format mzML or mzXML data plus the MSMS-Chooser submission template.

Considerations

  • Automated selections should be visually reviewed and validated before use as reference spectra.
